candidates.requirement: Release each cbor_serialize_alloc buffer through the installed allocator's matching free function, so repeated valid inputs retain available allocation quota.
candidates.target_route: A successful cbor_load of 0xE0 enters the success branch, serializes the ctrl item with cbor_serialize_alloc, calls free(buffer), and retains static allocator state for the next fuzz invocation.
candidates.failure_condition: Each successful nonempty serialization increments allocated_mem without the corresponding limited_free decrement. Repeating the valid input eventually makes limited_malloc reject a later load despite the serialization buffers having been freed.
candidates.alternative_paths: The success branch always calls free(buffer) and has no matching limited_free call for that buffer. The error branch avoids serialization but cannot restore the accumulated quota; decref of the items releases different allocations.
